name: appstack
description: Best practices for integrating and using the Appstack mobile attribution SDKs (Swift, Kotlin, React Native, Flutter): installation, initialization, event taxonomy, enhanced app campaigns, partner integrations, and troubleshooting.

interface.shortDescription: Integrate and use the Appstack mobile attribution SDKs the right way
interface.longDescription: Official Appstack-authored skill for integrating the Appstack mobile attribution SDKs across Swift (iOS), Kotlin (Android), React Native, and Flutter: installation, where to initialize on each platform, the event taxonomy (standard vs. custom events), enhanced app campaigns with revenue and matching parameters, partner integrations like Superwall and RevenueCat, and troubleshooting attribution and events not appearing.
defaultPrompt: Integrate the Appstack SDK into my app
Design an Appstack event taxonomy for enhanced app campaigns
Debug why my Appstack events are not appearing
